projectDescription: Stablecoin settlement and treasury infrastructure for licensed payment companies moving money into and out of Africa — one pathUSD balance on Tempo, instant settlement, automatic reconciliation, and optional shielded supplier payments on Zcash.
keyFeatures: Single pathUSD stablecoin treasury on Tempo replaces pre-funded nostro accounts in every country
Hub-and-spoke routing: N partner integrations instead of N×N bilateral corridors
0.6-second settlement finality on Tempo with 32-byte Corridor Reference in every chain's memo field
Two-hop cross-chain bridge via Across (Tempo → Base → Solana) to access ramp partner liquidity
Durable settlement saga engine with automatic reverse-order compensation on failure
Double-entry ledger with automatic three-way reconciliation across Tempo, Solana, and partner webhooks
Shielded B2B supplier payments via Zcash Ironwood with FROST 2-of-3 threshold vault control
Auditor disclosure via scoped viewing keys (per customer, per period)
7-day pre-funding forecast and low-balance alerts in the treasury console
Support for 32+ currencies across Africa, Asia, the Americas, and Europe
publicApiSurface: POST /webhooks/:partner — verified, idempotent partner webhook ingest (HMAC-SHA256)
RampPartner interface: rates(), openPayout(), openCollection(), getOrder(), verifyWebhook(), parseWebhook()
PayoutIntent: { corridor, amount, privacy, recipient, reference }
CorridorRef: 32-byte reference (version, kind, funding currency, beneficiary currency, flags, payout/batch id, customer tag, checksum)
Venue enum: tempo | base | solana | partner_fiat | zcash_ironwood
LegSpec: kind, from { venue, asset }, to { venue, asset }
pnpm tempo:smoke — testnet memo transfer and ledger booking
pnpm payout:demo — EUR→NGN public payout saga with forced-failure compensation
pnpm importer:demo — NGN collection then CNY supplier payout across the hub
pnpm zcash:frost — FROST 2-of-3 shielded Zcash batch payout
pnpm across:testnet — Live Across bridge deposit (Base Sepolia → Solana devnet)
pnpm console — Treasury console at http://localhost:4400
Across Swap API: GET /swap/approval → calldata, deposit, fill tracking
NEAR Intents 1Click quote endpoint (USDC → ZEC pricing)
Paj Public API v2: offramp orders (one-off funding address), onramp orders (virtual bank account), rates
